dialogues.jp: ｛ほおづえ／頬杖｝をついてため息をはく。
dialogues.en: I rested my chin on my hand and sighed.
dialogues.text: I rested my chin on my hand and sighed.

dialogues.jp:
「行くよ――なんて｛おおみえ／大見得｝切ったばかりなのに、
　どうしてお前は風邪をぶり返しますかね」
dialogues.en:
"Why do you get a cold again after telling me you're going
back to school?"
dialogues.text:
"Why do you get a cold again after telling me you're going
back to school?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「くしゅ！　……うぅぅ……そんなの風邪さん
　に言ってよ」
dialogues.en: "Achoo! ......Say that to my cold......"
dialogues.text: "Achoo! ......Say that to my cold......"

dialogues.jp:
ベッドから上半身を起こした音夢が、情けない
声でうなだれる。
dialogues.en: Nemu looked disappointed as she sat on her bed.
dialogues.text: Nemu looked disappointed as she sat on her bed.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「気をつけててもかかっちゃ――くちゅ！――
　う、どうしようもないでしょ」
dialogues.en: "I'm being careful... achoo! ...so what else can I do?"
dialogues.text: "I'm being careful... achoo! ...so what else can I do?"

dialogues.jp: また、ため息をおかゆに吹きかける。
dialogues.en: I blew on her rice porridge.
dialogues.text: I blew on her rice porridge.

dialogues.jp: 「ほれ、もう熱くないと思うぞ」
dialogues.en: "Here, I think it's not too hot."
dialogues.text: "Here, I think it's not too hot."

dialogues.jp: 特製の梅粥をすくって音夢の口に近づける。
dialogues.en:
I got a bite of the porridge on to the spoon and brought it
up to her mouth.
dialogues.text:
I got a bite of the porridge on to the spoon and brought it
up to her mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あの、自分で食べたいんだけど……」
dialogues.en: "Um...... I'd like to eat it myself..."
dialogues.text: "Um...... I'd like to eat it myself..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そんな、｛うつうつ／鬱々｝としたため息で冷ましたお粥っ
　て最悪だと思いますが？」
dialogues.en:
"Do you think that rice porridge cooled with your depressed
sigh will taste good?"
dialogues.text:
"Do you think that rice porridge cooled with your depressed
sigh will taste good?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ため息も有効活用しようという、俺の地球に
　やさしい心が分からないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"I'm doing everything I can to be environmentally friendly.
Don't you understand how kind I am to the earth?"
dialogues.text:
"I'm doing everything I can to be environmentally friendly.
Don't you understand how kind I am to the earth?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私にやさしくしてくださいよ……」
dialogues.en: "Why don't you be kind to me......"
dialogues.text: "Why don't you be kind to me......"

dialogues.jp: やさしく、ね。
dialogues.en: Kind, she said.
dialogues.text: Kind, she said.

dialogues.jp: 「自分で食べるか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to eat it yourself?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to eat it yourself?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うん。そんな、お兄ちゃんに食べさせてもら
　うなんて恥ずかしいしね」
dialogues.en: "Yes. It's embarrassing to be fed by you."
dialogues.text: "Yes. It's embarrassing to be fed by you."

dialogues.jp: てへへ、と笑って椀を音夢が受け取る。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiled and took the bowl from me.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiled and took the bowl from me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いただきます」
dialogues.en: "Thanks."
dialogues.text: "Thanks."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、どうやっても一口目は俺のため息つき
　だがな」
dialogues.en: "Whatever you do, it still has my sigh on top of it."
dialogues.text: "Whatever you do, it still has my sigh on top of it."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……だから……お兄ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "What did I tell you, oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "What did I tell you, oniichan?"

dialogues.jp:
拳を握り締めて音夢がゆっくりとした動作で、
粥から俺に視線を移す。
dialogues.en:
Nemu made a fist and moved her eyes slowly from the bowl to
me.
dialogues.text:
Nemu made a fist and moved her eyes slowly from the bowl to
me.

dialogues.jp:
今でも、成層圏まで叩き上げられるくらいの力
は残っているのかも知れない。
dialogues.en:
Maybe she still has enough power to knock me up to the
stratosphere.
dialogues.text:
Maybe she still has enough power to knock me up to the
stratosphere.

dialogues.jp: 少なくても天井までは楽勝だろう。
dialogues.en: Or at least to the ceiling.
dialogues.text: Or at least to the ceiling.

dialogues.jp: 「分かった、黙ってるよ」
dialogues.en: "I understand. I'll shut up."
dialogues.text: "I understand. I'll shut up."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「よろしい♪」
dialogues.en: "Good good."
dialogues.text: "Good good."

dialogues.jp:
言葉ほどの元気さはなく、ゆっくりとした動作
で口にスプーンが運ばれる。
dialogues.en:
She still wasn't feeling as well as she sounds. She moved
the spoon to her mouth slowly.
dialogues.text:
She still wasn't feeling as well as she sounds. She moved
the spoon to her mouth slowly.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ん……美味しい」
dialogues.en: "Mm...... It's delicious."
dialogues.text: "Mm...... It's delicious."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だろうな」
dialogues.en: "I know."
dialogues.text: "I know."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、なんで？」
dialogues.en: "What? Why do you say that?"
dialogues.text: "What? Why do you say that?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あぁ……いや」
dialogues.en: "Well...... nothing."
dialogues.text: "Well...... nothing."

dialogues.jp: 俺の愛情がこもっている――とは言えない。
dialogues.en: I can't say because I made it with love.
dialogues.text: I can't say because I made it with love.

dialogues.jp:
「お前の好きな味を知ってるからな。慣れだ慣
　れ」
dialogues.en: "I know what you like. It's based on past experience."
dialogues.text: "I know what you like. It's based on past experience."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……うん。お兄ちゃんは、私のことなんでも
　知ってるんだね」
dialogues.en: "Right. You know everything about me, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Right. You know everything about me, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ……まぁ、な」
dialogues.en: "Well, pretty much."
dialogues.text: "Well, pretty much."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「夜はサンドイッチにしてやるよ。お前の好き
　なきゅうりの入ってるやつ」
dialogues.en: Or rather to the details.
dialogues.text: Or rather to the details.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うわっ♪　ありがとう、お兄ちゃん♪」
dialogues.en:
"I'll make you a sandwich for dinner. The one you like with
cucumber."
dialogues.text:
"I'll make you a sandwich for dinner. The one you like with
cucumber."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Really? Thank you!"
dialogues.text: "Really? Thank you!"

dialogues.jp: 音夢の笑顔が心地よい。
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.jp: だからこそ、辛い。
dialogues.en: Her smile makes me comfortable.
dialogues.text: Her smile makes me comfortable.

dialogues.jp: 秘めた想いは、もう、口にしないと届かない。
dialogues.en: That's why it hurts me.
dialogues.text: That's why it hurts me.

dialogues.jp: ちゅうぶらりんなまま、俺は音夢を見ている。
dialogues.en: My secret feelings don't reach her unless I say it out loud.
dialogues.text: My secret feelings don't reach her unless I say it out loud.

dialogues.en: I'm looking at her wondering.
dialogues.text: I'm looking at her wondering.

dialogues.jp:
ふと、音夢のベッドに一片の桜の花びらを見つ
けた。
つまみ上げる。
dialogues.en: Then, I found a petal of a cherry blossom by her bed.
dialogues.text: Then, I found a petal of a cherry blossom by her bed.

dialogues.jp: 「……どこから降って来たんだ？」
dialogues.en: I picked it up.
dialogues.text: I picked it up.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃんの服についてたんじゃない？」
dialogues.en: "...Where did it come from?"
dialogues.text: "...Where did it come from?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか？」
dialogues.en: "Maybe it came in from outside on your uniform."
dialogues.text: "Maybe it came in from outside on your uniform."

dialogues.jp: どこの桜だろう。
dialogues.en: "Do you think so?"
dialogues.text: "Do you think so?"

dialogues.jp: その赤い色には確かに見覚えがある。
dialogues.en: I wonder which cherry tree.
dialogues.text: I wonder which cherry tree.

dialogues.jp: なにかが、決定的にずれた。
dialogues.en: But I remember the red color of this petal.
dialogues.text: But I remember the red color of this petal.

dialogues.jp: この赤は、血の色を連想させた。
dialogues.en: Something was definitely wrong.
dialogues.text: Something was definitely wrong.

dialogues.jp: 音夢の吐き出した心の形。
dialogues.en: I saw this red color in my bed.
dialogues.text: I saw this red color in my bed.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「くしゅん！　……うぅ」
dialogues.en: "Achoo!"
dialogues.text: "Achoo!"

dialogues.jp: 鼻をすすって音夢が眉をよせる。
dialogues.en: Nemu sniffed her nose and frowned.
dialogues.text: Nemu sniffed her nose and frowned.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、それ、あそこの桜の色だね」
dialogues.en: "Oh, this is from that cherry tree."
dialogues.text: "Oh, this is from that cherry tree."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あそこ？」
dialogues.en: "Which one?"
dialogues.text: "Which one?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「え、に……あ……お兄ちゃんと私とさくらの
　秘密基地」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, the one from our secret hideout. Remember? You and
Sakura and I made a secret hideout."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, the one from our secret hideout. Remember? You and
Sakura and I made a secret hideout."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……そうか」

そう、それは多分――あの、夢の中の枯れない
桜の赤だ。
dialogues.en:
She was right. This red color is from that everlasting
cherry tree from my dream.
dialogues.text:
She was right. This red color is from that everlasting
cherry tree from my dream.

dialogues.jp: ◆おかゆと桜の花びら◆
dialogues.en: ◆Rice porridge and a cherry blossom petal◆
dialogues.text: ◆Rice porridge and a cherry blossom petal◆

dialogues.jp:
せっかく調子がよさそうなので音夢と一緒に学
園に行こうと思ったのに、当の音夢自身が寝込
んでしまった。
dialogues.en:
I thought we should go back to school together since Nemu
had been feeling well lately. But Nemu got a cold again.
dialogues.text:
I thought we should go back to school together since Nemu
had been feeling well lately. But Nemu got a cold again.

dialogues.jp:
ぶつくさと文句を言うが、音夢とふたりでいら
れる時間がなんだか嬉しい。
dialogues.en: I complained, but I was happy to be with her alone.
dialogues.text: I complained, but I was happy to be with her alone.

dialogues.jp:
そんな中、また例の桜が音夢からこぼれ落ちて
きた……。
dialogues.en:
Then, I found that cherry blossom were coming out of her
again......
dialogues.text:
Then, I found that cherry blossom were coming out of her
again......
